scope: Interactive acceptance diagnostics; no mechanical parameters inferred
sections: Gamepad Interface: timestamp, mapping, axes, buttons
decisions: Copy all browser-reported axes and button value/pressed/touched fields before standard-layout validation, without calling them raw USB HID packets.
Unrecognized mappings remain visible for inspection but cannot drive the asset.
Keep browser snapshot separate from the 21-channel Float32 transport; unavailable channels and unconfigured represented coordinates display null, not fabricated zeros.
Show browser source timestamp and receipt performance.now separately in milliseconds. Their difference is not a measured physical input or USB transport latency.
Display kinematic coordinates in rad or m using the same toJoint mapping as rendering. Configured signals do not establish physical accuracy.
Lifecycle clear removes old snapshot and time metadata along with input values.
harness: Retired with the schema-1 viewer; the current page exposes raw and represented values directly and uses debug.mjs only for browser acceptance.
